items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I see we was up there in Carlton playing one night, with Handy's job, with Law & Quarter.

ctx.x: You could throw all the bars before you get home? Huh?

Might take a whole day to get home, you could throw all those bars. You could throw all these, you could throw them in there. And they went ahead and join that, you understand? And then we went back down to the entertainers downtown there, where Russ had, he used to put us in jail every Monday. Every Monday? Every Monday. And get right out. Why did he do that? Why did they put you in jail? I don't know. We just picked us up, raved the place. How long did you stay in jail? Until they called our name and we come…
Was he better than Guy Kelly?
